name: Cooler Master MM712
description: The logo light of the Cooler Master MM712 mouse, through its direct mode. Adapted from OpenRGB's CMMM712Controller (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. The save command, mode / profile writes, DPI and polling rate are never touched; shutdown turns direct mode off, back to the mouse's own mode. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/coolermaster-mm712.md.
